message.subject: Adapter piece HI — counterproposal
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. Your Q3 scorecard records on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70270@2026Q3), so we need a more competitive commercial package before agreeing to a price increase.

For the 6,650-piece annual requirement and 12-month contract, please confirm either EUR 15.31 per piece with payment at 14 days, or EUR 15.57 per piece with payment at 90 days. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged. The first option retains your preferred payment terms in exchange for the lower price.

batch.note: Anchor below current pricing while offering equivalent-cost payment alternatives; delivery performance supports resisting the increase.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI — revised package
message.body:
Thank you for reducing your price to EUR 17.12. In return, we can improve our proposal to EUR 15.53 per piece with payment at 14 days, retaining your standard payment terms. Alternatively, we can offer EUR 15.80 per piece with payment at 90 days.

Both options cover 6,650 pieces over 12 months, with all other enquiry terms unchanged. Please make a further price adjustment and confirm which package you can support.

batch.note: Supplier moved on price; reciprocate with a modest concession and retain payment alternatives.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI — next price adjustment
message.body:
Thank you for the further reduction. In exchange, we can increase our proposal to EUR 15.64 per piece with payment at 14 days, retaining your standard payment terms. Alternatively, we offer EUR 15.80 per piece with payment at 60 days.

Both packages cover 6,650 pieces over 12 months, with the other enquiry terms unchanged. Please confirm the package you can support with a further price adjustment.

batch.note: Supplier reduced price again; reciprocate with a smaller concession and offer equivalent payment structures.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI – revised proposal
message.body: Thank you for reducing your offer. In return, we can improve our proposal to EUR 15.69 per piece, with payment in 14 days, for the fixed annual volume of 6,650 pieces and 12-month contract. This retains your standard payment terms; please confirm this package so we can conclude.

batch.note: Supplier has moved again. Make a smaller reciprocal concession and retain standard payment terms.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI – revised proposal
message.body: Thank you for reducing your offer to EUR 16.07 per piece. In return, we can improve our proposal to EUR 15.71 per piece, with payment in 14 days, for the fixed annual volume of 6,650 pieces and 12-month contract. Please confirm this package so we can conclude the agreement.

batch.note: Supplier continues making substantial price reductions; reciprocate with a smaller concession while retaining its standard payment terms.
